title: Per-neighbor EMA/loss/sample-count state absent in Rust and C (node-scoped aggregates only)
description:
Req R-02-018 (spec/02-physical-link.md 3.5, MUST): 'Per-neighbor state MUST track EMA values, loss rate, and sample count.'

Classification: implemented+tested in Python; not-implemented in Rust and C (both track node-scoped aggregates, not per-neighbor records).
Evidence: python/src/lichen/link/adaptive_sf.py:47-76 NeighborState{assigned_sf, ema_snr, ema_loss, samples} + update_neighbor matches the spec pseudocode shape.
Rust: rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs:321-400 RfHealthMetrics is node-scoped (density, load_factor_fp, packet_loss_rate_fp); no per-neighbor table. adaptive_sf_select takes a scalar assigned_sf, not a neighbor record.
C: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/rf_health.c node-scoped likewise; lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/include/lichen/routing/gradient.h:79 tracks only current_sf.
Tests: ccp16/ccp_ema_update_integer vectors (rust+python) cover the EMA math, not per-neighbor bookkeeping.

Suggested placement: per-neighbor rf-health record in rust/lichen-core (keyed by peer pubkey) and in lichen C neighbor/gradient records. Related existing beads: worker6-b7z9.30 (C adaptive_sf_select steps absent), worker6-b7z9.29 (CCP-15 metrics layer).
